byStage.text: Her visions appear to have no practical value.
In round 1, the card opposite her left neighbour has no abilities.

ability.notes: frontLeft = the enemy card facing her left neighbour. Stun = no_buff + no_damage (two buffs, as the wiki says they are separate: a suspended Magmamancer still suppresses but no longer dazes - no_buff is the only handler not blocked by noBuffsAllowed). Two buffs of one type with disjoint rounds are fine: the first matching one fires.
